is_anopheles.evidence: Tests reference strains of Anopheles gambiae (Kisumu and Acerkis) alongside Culex pipiens (page 2, page 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Examines the Ace-1 G119S mutation (AChE1 G119S) conferring organophosphate/carbamate resistance (page 1-2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No field-collected mosquitoes are genotyped. Only laboratory strains (Kisumu, Acerkis) and in silico population genetics simulations are studied; no empirical field genotype counts or frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Only long-term colonized laboratory strains (Kisumu and Acerkis) and Culex laboratory colonies were used (page 6); no African field populations were sampled or tested.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary laboratory experimental study reporting chemical screening, biochemical assays, and larval bioassays.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field mosquito collections were performed.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field mosquito collections were performed.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable; no field surveillance data.

supplement.evidence: The study only uses laboratory colonies and chemical assays; supplementary tables S1-S3 concern chemical properties and in vitro kinetics.

assessment.summary: This study investigates pyrimidinetrione furan-substituted (PTF) compounds that act as selective acetylcholinesterase inhibitors preferentially targeting the Ace-1 G119S resistant mutant over wild-type AChE1. Bioassays were conducted using established laboratory colonies (An. gambiae Kisumu and Acerkis, as well as Culex pipiens strains Slab, SR, and Ducos). Because no African field-collected populations were genotyped, the study does not meet inclusion criteria.
exclusion_reasons: No extractable genotype data from field populations (reports_extractable_genotype_data is false).
No African field-collected mosquito populations tested; only laboratory colonies used (african_field_population is false).
